Subject: Physics
Chapters: EM Waves; Ray Optics & Optical Instruments; Wave Optics
How to write the answer: Draw ray diagrams with arrows and labels. For derivations: diagram, steps, then the final formula boxed.
How to prepare fast: The lens-maker's formula, refraction through a prism, Young's double slit and the microscope and telescope come up again and again.

Subject: Physics
Chapters: Moving Charges & Magnetism; Magnetism & Matter; Electromagnetic Induction; Alternating Current
How to write the answer: State the law, draw the figure, then derive. In numericals use SI units and give the answer with its unit.
How to prepare fast: Learn the derivations: uses of Biot–Savart and Ampère's laws, force between parallel wires, self and mutual inductance, the LCR circuit and the transformer.

Subject: Physics
Chapters: Electric Charges & Fields; Electrostatic Potential & Capacitance; Current Electricity
How to write the answer: For Gauss's law, draw the Gaussian surface. For Kirchhoff's laws, mark the current directions first.
How to prepare fast: Practise capacitor combinations, the Wheatstone and metre bridges, and the potential due to a dipole.

Subject: Physics
Chapters: Dual Nature of Radiation & Matter; Atoms; Nuclei
How to write the answer: Short, formula-based answers. Draw the photoelectric graphs with labelled axes.
How to prepare fast: Very scoring: Einstein's photoelectric equation, de Broglie wavelength, the Bohr model and the binding-energy curve.

Subject: Physics
How to write the answer: Draw the circuit diagrams and the I–V graphs for the p-n junction and rectifiers.
How to prepare fast: One chapter: learn half-wave and full-wave rectifiers and the diode characteristics.

Subject: Chemistry
How to write the answer: Write the cell notation and the Nernst equation with values, and give units for conductivity.
How to prepare fast: Practise Nernst equation, molar conductivity and Kohlrausch's law numericals from past papers.

Subject: Chemistry
How to write the answer: Write reactions with the conditions over the arrow. For a named reaction, give the equation, not just the name.
How to prepare fast: Make a sheet of named reactions — aldol, Cannizzaro, Clemmensen, HVZ — and read it daily.

Subject: Chemistry
How to write the answer: In colligative-property numericals, write the formula and the units at each step.
How to prepare fast: Raoult's law, the van't Hoff factor and colligative numericals.

Subject: Chemistry
How to write the answer: Show the integrated rate law and each step of the log calculation.
How to prepare fast: First-order and half-life numericals and the Arrhenius equation.

Subject: Chemistry
How to write the answer: Give each 'reason' in one line, such as why transition metals are coloured.
How to prepare fast: Learn the trend-based 'give reasons' questions and the lanthanoid contraction.

Subject: Chemistry
How to write the answer: Put the IUPAC name, hybridisation and magnetic nature in a small table.
How to prepare fast: Practise naming and crystal-field splitting for ten complexes.

Subject: Chemistry
How to write the answer: Short definitions and structures, such as glucose and the peptide bond.
How to prepare fast: A theory-only chapter, so quick revision gives sure marks.

Subject: Chemistry
How to write the answer: Explain SN1 and SN2 with the mechanism and conditions.
How to prepare fast: Learn the conversions and the mechanisms.

Subject: Chemistry
How to write the answer: Write reactions with the reagents, and the tests that tell compounds apart.
How to prepare fast: Practise conversions and distinguishing tests.

Subject: Chemistry
How to write the answer: Give the order of basicity with the reason; the Hofmann and Gabriel reactions.
How to prepare fast: Learn the distinguishing tests and the reactions of diazonium salts.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Continuity & Differentiability; Application of Derivatives; Integrals; Application of Integrals; Differential Equations
How to write the answer: Show every step, because step marks matter. Draw the region in area questions and write + C.
How to prepare fast: Nearly half the paper: do every NCERT integration exercise, then maxima and minima word problems.

Subject: Mathematics
How to write the answer: Write vectors with arrows or hats. In 3D, state the formula, such as for shortest distance, before using it.
How to prepare fast: Shortest distance between lines and the angle between lines are frequent five-mark questions.

Subject: Mathematics
How to write the answer: Check an inverse by multiplying back to the identity, and show the cofactors in a grid.
How to prepare fast: Solving equations by the matrix method is almost always asked.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Relations and Functions; Inverse Trigonometric Functions
How to write the answer: For an equivalence relation, prove reflexive, symmetric and transitive one by one.
How to prepare fast: Learn the table of principal-value branches.

Subject: Mathematics
How to write the answer: Describe the events in words first. For Bayes' theorem, draw a tree.
How to prepare fast: Bayes' theorem and probability distributions come up often.

Subject: Mathematics
How to write the answer: Draw the graph neatly, shade the feasible region and make a table of corner points.
How to prepare fast: Full marks with one well-practised method.

Subject: Biology
Chapters: Principles of Inheritance & Variation; Molecular Basis of Inheritance; Evolution
How to write the answer: Draw crosses with Punnett squares. Explain the lac operon and DNA replication with diagrams.
How to prepare fast: The largest unit: start with Molecular Basis of Inheritance.

Subject: Biology
Chapters: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants; Human Reproduction; Reproductive Health
How to write the answer: Labelled diagrams — embryo sac, sections of testis and ovary, the menstrual cycle.
How to prepare fast: Practise the diagrams daily and learn each process as a flowchart.

Subject: Biology
Chapters: Human Health & Disease; Microbes in Human Welfare
How to write the answer: Give disease, pathogen, symptoms and prevention as a table.
How to prepare fast: Revising in tables is fastest.

Subject: Biology
Chapters: Biotechnology: Principles & Processes; Biotechnology & its Applications
How to write the answer: Explain steps in order, such as recombinant DNA and PCR, as a flowchart.
How to prepare fast: Learn the steps of recombinant DNA technology and PCR, and Bt crops.

Subject: Biology
How to write the answer: Use graphs, such as population growth curves, and examples.
How to prepare fast: Short chapters and quick marks.

Subject: Accountancy
Chapters: Fundamentals; change in profit-sharing ratio; admission; retirement and death; dissolution
How to write the answer: Show working notes. Every journal entry needs a narration. Prepare ledgers and the balance sheet neatly.
How to prepare fast: Almost half the paper: practise admission and retirement questions from past papers.

Subject: Accountancy
Chapters: Issue of Shares; Issue of Debentures
How to write the answer: Use the correct account names and show calculations in working notes.
How to prepare fast: Practise forfeiture and re-issue of shares, and issue of debentures.

Subject: Accountancy
Chapters: Financial statements; comparative and common-size statements; accounting ratios
How to write the answer: Write the ratio formula, then the values, then the answer.
How to prepare fast: Keep all ratio formulas on one sheet.

Subject: Accountancy
How to write the answer: Follow the format: operating, investing and financing activities.
How to prepare fast: Practise three complete cash-flow statements.

Subject: Economics
How to write the answer: Use data and current examples, and answer in points with headings.
How to prepare fast: Half the paper: make one page of notes per chapter.

Subject: Economics
Chapters: Aggregate demand, the multiplier, deficient and excess demand
How to write the answer: Draw diagrams with labelled axes and show the multiplier steps.
How to prepare fast: Numericals on the multiplier and aggregate demand.

Subject: Economics
Chapters: National income, methods of calculation, GDP and welfare
How to write the answer: Write the formula, then the values, showing each step.
How to prepare fast: Practise national-income numericals by all three methods.

Subject: Economics
Chapters: Money, credit creation, functions of the RBI
How to write the answer: Define the terms and explain the RBI's tools.
How to prepare fast: Quick theory revision.

Subject: Economics
How to write the answer: Give the formulas for fiscal, revenue and primary deficit.
How to prepare fast: Short and scoring.

Subject: Economics
Chapters: Balance of payments; foreign exchange rate
How to write the answer: Use the balance-of-payments table format.
How to prepare fast: Short and scoring.

Subject: English Core
Chapters: Flamingo; Vistas; notice, invitation, letter, article
How to write the answer: Follow formats and word limits exactly, and refer to events and characters by name in literature answers.
How to prepare fast: Read a summary of each chapter, practise one of each writing format, and solve three unseen passages from past papers.
